description:
Math on a Sheet of Glass, Extended with User-Made Scripties. A WinUI 3 Calculator for Windows 11!

Lamina ✦ is a WinUI 3 calculator that is not only includes a Regular Calculator but also something called "Scripties". She supports Mensuration, Finance, Currency Conversion, Unit Conversions And More!, making her a Very Extendable Option.
- BRAND NEW ADVANCED CALCULATOR UI!!!!
- Added a Recall Expression Button to Advanced Calculator.
- AN EXPRESSION EDITOR? I CAN TYPE MY OWN EXPRESSION?! Yes, do anything that NCalc Allows!
- Info Button in Advanced Calculator to tell Newbies what Ln(), Atan() , etc means.
- IMRPVED HISTORY UI : Now its a Sidebar on Large Windows and a Popup on Small Windows for BOTH PAGES.
- Refinement in History List's Padding.
- Made History UI Close Button Accented.
- HISTORY IS FINALLY USEFUL : Added a Use Button beside each Entry and the Calculated Value can now be Repurposed!
- Removed Formula in Base Converter as it's Useless.
- NCalc updated from v1.3.8 to 7.1.0 for DSL and Advanced Calculator!
- NEW EASTER EGG in Advanced Calculator! ( Try Spamming Div by Zero on Advanced Calculator )
